notes: Primary source: official Sony datasheet for FW-75BZ40L hosted at av-iq.com (mirrors the pro.sony spec page content, which returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch) — confirms 4 HDMI inputs (HDCP2.3), 1 composite video input, 1 analog audio input, 1 digital audio output, 2 USB ports, 1 Ethernet input, RS-232C control, rated power consumption 299W. Panel-diagram and connector-type details (RS-232C is a 3.5mm stereo mini-jack, not D-sub; AV IN is a 3.5mm 4-pole breakout to composite+stereo RCA; DIGITAL AUDIO OUT is TOSLINK optical) were confirmed against Sony's official multi-model Reference Guide (doc 5-049-506-11(1), "LCD Monitor", covering FW-98BZ50L/85BZ40L/85BZ35L/85BZ30L/75BZ40L/75BZ35L/75BZ30L/65BZ40L/65BZ35L/65BZ30L/55BZ40L/55BZ35L/55BZ30L/50BZ30L/43BZ30L), which includes the exact rear/side connector diagram and pinouts shared by this model group. USB port speed (2.0 vs higher) is not stated in any source found — omitted per instructions since grade could not be confirmed. LAN port speed (eth-1g etc.) not stated by Sony for this model — omitted, grade not confirmed. AC power inlet: Sony's reference guide does not include a power-input diagram; classified as `iec` based on OEM replacement power-cord listings for sibling models in the same BZ30L/BZ40L family (detachable IEC cord), but the exact IEC variant (C13/C14 vs C7) was not directly confirmed — flagged as the main residual uncertainty. This is a wall-mount/tabletop professional display, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Model number written as "FW-75BZ40L" (Sony's own hyphenated form); commonly also sold/listed as "FW75BZ40L" (no hyphen) by US retailers — same product.

ports.name: HDMI IN 3 (eARC/ARC)
ports.note: Supports eARC/ARC for connecting an audio system; HDCP 2.3

ports.name: HDMI IN 4 (DVI)
ports.note: Also accepts DVI source via HDMI-DVI adapter (not supplied); HDCP 2.3

ports.name: HDMI 4 AUDIO IN
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo mini-jack; carries analog audio companion for HDMI IN 4 when used with a DVI source

ports.name: AV IN
ports.note: 3.5mm 4-pole mini-jack (pinout: L / Video / Ground / R); composite video + stereo audio via supplied/optional breakout cable to RCA

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Wired network; USB/version speed not stated by Sony (commonly 1G on this class of display)

ports.name: REMOTE RS-232C
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo mini-plug (TIP/RING/SLEEVE = RXD/TXD/GND), not a D-sub connector

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Detachable IEC power cord (replacement cords sold as standard IEC cable for this display family); exact C13/C14 vs C7 rating not confirmed in available documentation
